description: This file implements authentication and authorization logic for a FastAPI application, including JWT token decoding, user role and permission loading, and principal extraction.

classes.name: Principal
classes.description: Dataclass representing an authenticated user with roles, permissions, and identifiers.

methods.name: _load_roles_and_permissions
methods.description: Loads user roles and permissions from the database based on user ID.

methods.name: _load_employee_id
methods.description: Retrieves the employee ID associated with a user, if any.

methods.name: get_current_principal
methods.description: Extracts and returns the current authenticated principal from a JWT token.

methods.name: require_permissions
methods.description: Creates a dependency that enforces specified permissions for access control.
